diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

helm_release.karpenter explicitly depends on module.eks, but its values already reference module.eks.cluster_name and module.eks.cluster_endpoint. The supplied graph therefore already establishes this dependency implicitly; remove the duplicate depends_on entry.

helm_release.karpenter deploys a controller whose credentials come from EKS Pod Identity (module.karpenter enables create_pod_identity_association), but it has no dependency on aws_eks_addon.eks_pod_identity_agent. Creating the association does not install the credential-serving agent. The controller can therefore start before the agent is available and fail AWS authentication. Order the release after the Pod Identity agent add-on; that also orders it after the bootstrap node group, on which the add-on already depends.
